note: The peoples of Russia whose given names and surnames differ from the Russian ones.
Population is the 2021 census count and becomes the weight in the merged list, so a
row drawn from russia.person.* looks like the country rather than like an even split
between Russians and Tuvans. Russians are here as one people among the rest — that is
what makes russia.person.* usable WITHOUT the ru locale bundle, the way a country pack
is supposed to be. Their names come from the ru locale source rather than being copied.
Peoples who today give their children Russian names and are distinguished mainly by
surname (Chuvash, Mordvins, Mari, Udmurts, Komi) are deliberately absent: a made-up
list of 'Chuvash given names' would be worse than no list.
